pieces.name: Swipe Carousel
pieces.summary: Swipe through your own card designs or image cards that gently settle in the center.

items.type: readonly T[] where T extends {id: string}
items.description: Required array with unique stable IDs; empty lists supported. Without renderCard, use the existing SwipeCarouselItem image/alt/title/text/optional cta shape. Other item shapes require renderCard.

startIndex.description: Initial zero-based card; rounded and clamped. Later changes do not control selection.

options: Any valid CSS width, e.g. 280px, 70vw, or clamp(220px, 70vw, 360px)
cardWidth.description: Capped to carousel width minus 32px. The cardAspect prop controls the aspect ratio.

gap.description: Distance between card centers as a share of card width; clamped to range.

sideScale.description: Scale of side cards; clamped to range.

fanOnView.description: Fan out once per mounted carousel when it enters view; scrolling out and back does not replay.

onChange.description: Called once when the selected index changes, including data shrinking; not on initial render or selecting the current card.

label.description: Accessible name for the carousel region, e.g. What’s Inside. Use a distinct name when a page has multiple carousels.

renderCard.description: Replaces all content inside the motion frame. State: index (zero-based), count, active (selected center/destination), ready (active and settled, when built-in text begins fading), loadImage (center plus immediate neighbors first, all cards after fan-out or interaction). Gate image src with loadImage. Custom content stays inert off-center and while settling. Required for item shapes other than SwipeCarouselItem.

options: Any positive CSS aspect ratio, e.g. 1 / 1 or 4 / 3
cardAspect.description: Frame aspect ratio. Use auto with in-flow custom content to size the card by its contents; height is not animated.

options: Object containing any subset of borderRadius, background and boxShadow
cardStyle.description: Static frame decoration; omitted fields retain the built-in look. Width, aspect, transforms, opacity and stacking remain controlled by the carousel.

pieces.reducedMotion: useReducedMotion skips the fan-out and all springs. Navigation and content changes are instant; direct dragging and all controls remain available.
